capabilities: Search items and stock positions from a dashboard by name, id, tag, place or state
Add an item card and its first stock position in one step with similar-name checks
Move stock between places and states, or mark it used up or disposed
Attach photos to items and locations
Print and scan QR labels that open item cards or filter by place
extras: Not yet in the community catalog; install via BRAT or by copying release files manually. Requires Obsidian 1.7.2+ with the core Bases plugin enabled, and offers an optional filament module with extra fields.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track physical belongings with quantities, locations and stock states across plain notes.
summary: Home inventory manager that keeps items and stock positions as markdown notes and adds a fast dashboard for search, adding, moving and using things up.
